scope: Static pinned dynamic allocation/lifetime consumer contract; not native backing or hardware qualification.

result.reference_revision: 453d8875f815bf9dfad9035982861226a4823a6c; reference not Xiaomi exact stock source
minimum_native_changes: Reject key reuse with changed size/flags/align; explicit local stricter policy, not an OEM claim.

Persistent real NativeAdrenoMemory ownership per attempted allocation including uncounted/failed slots. Preserve raw allocation/import/gate errors separately; do not erase failure descriptor or retry.
Separate CPU backing from GPU-global/GMU-import/IPC/preallocated fence/memstore; no PA-as-IOVA, no invented domain or translation lease.
GMU import failure after GPU allocation must remain retained/quarantined; destructor must not release it.
HOST_INIT zeroing requires actual stopped/exclusive lifetime; reset is not free. Completion of HFI transport or ACK does not retire backing.
result.native_API: Current upstream NativeAdrenoMemory::allocate/release/quarantine getters; no pool reservation, WC policy or device hold is selected.
missing_native_contracts: Actual GMU domain and GPU VA import rights
Per-kind physical backing suitability and true stop/release proof
